from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
import json,hashlib
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_bank_accepted_bill_discount_source_qualification_v1'
assert not (OUT/'catalog_receipts.json').exists(),'来源目录尝试已经保存，禁止重取。'
entries=json.loads((OUT/'entry_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
entry=next(x for x in entries if x['source_id']=='entry_2' and x['successfully_received'])
body=BeautifulSoup((ROOT/entry['path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser')
forex=[urljoin(entry['final_url'],a['href']) for a in body.select('a[href]') if a.get_text(' ',strip=True)=='中国外汇交易中心']
assert forex,'原首页没有官方基础设施交叉入口。'
tasks=[
('market','http://www.shcpe.com.cn/content/shcpe/market.html'),
('about','http://www.shcpe.com.cn/content/shcpe/about.html'),
('official_forex_cross_reference',forex[0])]
def fetch(task):
    key,url=task;receipt={'source_id':key,'url':url,'attempts':1,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
    try:
        response=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,25),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 historical-source-research'})
        path=OUT/'sources'/(key+'.html')
        with path.open('xb') as f:f.write(response.content)
        soup=BeautifulSoup(response.content,'html.parser')
        for tag in soup(['script','style']):tag.extract()
        text=soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)
        original=BeautifulSoup(response.content,'html.parser')
        links=[{'title':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'url':urljoin(response.url,a.get('href',''))} for a in original.select('a[href]')]
        receipt.update(status_code=response.status_code,final_url=response.url,path=path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),title=original.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if original.title else None,
            relevant_links=[x for x in links if any(s in x['title'] for s in ['利率','曲线','收益率','数据','票据','票交所']) or 'shcpe.' in x['url']][:80],
            javascript_files=[urljoin(response.url,x['src']) for x in original.select('script[src]')][-25:],
            body_text=text,successfully_received=response.status_code==200)
    except requests.RequestException as error:
        receipt.update(successfully_received=False,error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error)[:800])
    receipt['completed_at']=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
    return receipt
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as executor:receipts=list(executor.map(fetch,tasks))
with (OUT/'catalog_receipts.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
    json.dump(receipts,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
for item in receipts:
    short={k:v for k,v in item.items() if k not in ['body_text','relevant_links','javascript_files']}
    print(json.dumps(short,ensure_ascii=False))
    print('正文：'+item.get('body_text','')[:3000])
    print('相关入口：'+json.dumps(item.get('relevant_links',[]),ensure_ascii=False)[:1800])
print('额外原始请求已使用3/12；没有取得并准入历史利率序列。')
